orders_comprador_ck.name: orders_comprador_ck
orders_comprador_ck.value:
"orders"."status" = 'draft' or ("orders"."comprador_nome" is not null
          and "orders"."comprador_email" is not null and "orders"."comprador_cpf" is not null)

orders_canal_ck.name: orders_canal_ck
orders_canal_ck.value:
("orders"."canal" = 'online' and "orders"."metodo_externo" is null)
          or ("orders"."canal" <> 'online' and "orders"."provider_transaction_id" is null)

reservations_liberada_ck.name: reservations_liberada_ck
reservations_liberada_ck.value:
("reservations"."liberada" = false and "reservations"."liberada_em" is null and "reservations"."liberada_motivo" is null)
          or ("reservations"."liberada" = true and "reservations"."liberada_em" is not null and "reservations"."liberada_motivo" is not null)
